rdfs:label: isReplacedBy
rdfs:comment: A related resource that supplants, displaces, or supersedes the described resource.
notes: Inverse of `urn:solid:replaces`. Use on the older resource to point at its successor — readers can follow the chain to the current version. Inside the registry, the term-file `supersededBy` field (schema/term.schema.json) is mapped to dcterms:isReplacedBy in context.jsonld.

examples.title: v1 spec pointing at its successor

history.note: Removed the non-existent supersededBy term ref from seeAlso; notes clarify the supersededBy schema field mapping.
